text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P1 - elevated inference tail latency for embeddings-service (us-west-2). Automated pager sent. War room: https://meet.redwood/warroom/1791234567 — please ack and join.
Jordan (oncall): acked, joining war room now. I saw increased 95th/99th on the dashboard. No KB yet.
Priya (SRE): I got the pager. Adding logs and recent deployment diff to the war room. Assigning incident owner: @Mateo
Mateo (Eng): taking owner. Looking at recent model rollout and batching changes. Initial hypothesis: new batcher config + cold KV cache pressure.
Jordan (oncall): confirmed pager delivery to my phone.
Mateo (Eng): checking autoscale group sizes and active GPUs. If we can't clear KV backlog in 5m, plan to divert traffic to fallback model variant.
Priya (SRE): can you also snapshot current kv cache metrics? run: ```curl -s "https://internal-metrics/api/kvcache?range=5m" | jq .``` and paste output in war room.
Mateo (Eng): pasted short dump in war room. KV outstanding ops spiked ~x12 since 12:01 UTC.
ops-bot: Reminder: use the internal status template when we have confirmed customer impact. Template:
```
[INCIDENT SUMMARY]
- What: elevated inference latency for embeddings-service (us-west-2)
- When: started ~2026-03-17T12:00Z
- Impact: higher tail latency causing timeouts for some API requests (affecting <10% of requests to embeddings endpoints)
- Mitigation in progress: rerouting traffic, scaling capacity, investigating KV cache pressure
- Next update: in 15 minutes
```
Asha (PM): looping in @product-ops and @support for customer comms. If impact > 10% we need to prepare a statuspage banner.
Jordan (oncall): quick check: are any Dedicated customers reporting errors? Support queue shows 3 tickets with timeouts, all from EU customers hitting the same endpoint.
Priya (SRE): EU traffic hitting same backend via us-west-2 edge — may be amplified by one of the recent routing changes. Adding routing team to war room.
Mateo (Eng): mitigation step 1: temporarily disable new batcher policy (rollback snippet):
```
PATCH /api/configs/batcher
{"policy": "previous"}
```
Doing that now.
Mateo (Eng): rollback applied, waiting for metrics to settle.
Jordan (oncall): can someone draft the initial status page message based on ops-bot template? I'll post to statuspage after approval.
Priya (SRE): draft below — please review/edit, then I'll sign off:
```
We are investigating elevated latency for embeddings requests routed through us-west-2. Some requests are timing out; we are rerouting traffic and rolling back a batching config to reduce tail latency. Users may see intermittent failures or slower responses. We will update within 15 minutes.
```
Asha (PM): looks good. Add: "Customers using dedicated endpoints may see higher latency; no data loss reported."
Jordan (oncall): posting to statuspage now (drafted message + severity). Will ping channel when live.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager acknowledged by Jordan. War room link: https://meet.redwood/warroom/1791234567
Mateo (Eng): metrics show 95th latency dropping after rollback. Continuing to monitor for 10m before full close.
Priya (SRE): prepping a post-incident internal blameless summary template for root cause and mitigations. Keeping everyone posted.
Jordan (oncall): thanks — staying on until stable. If any customer escalations come in, route to this thread and war room link.
Mateo (Eng): assigning follow-ups: investigate batcher config regression, KV cache sizing, and routing policy interaction. I'll own the batcher fix.
Asha (PM): coordinating support replies. Posting standard customer notice to ticket responses now.
incident-bot: Incident declared P1; incident channel created: #inc-1791234567. Use /incident checklist to log actions.
Jordan (oncall): closing loop for now — monitoring. Next update in 10 minutes unless something changes. :thumbsup:
